Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join assays on chembl_id CHEMBL4649955, then activities on assay_id, then molecule_dictionary on molregno, then compound_structures on molregno. Filter where standard_value is not null and standard_relation equals '='. Sort by chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
